label: Salon / Spa
description: Hair salons, unisex salons, beauty parlours, spas, nail and skin studios.

headlineKpi.label: New reviews per week
headlineKpi.help: Salons are chosen on recent proof. A stream of fresh, honest reviews beats a high but stale rating.

issueTaxonomy.label: Unhappy with the result
issueTaxonomy.action: Add a two-minute consultation before every chemical or cutting service: agree the result in words and show a reference, then confirm before starting.

issueTaxonomy.label: Appointment / waiting problems
issueTaxonomy.action: Stop double-booking the same stylist: block realistic service durations and confirm every appointment the day before.

issueTaxonomy.label: Price quoted vs price charged
issueTaxonomy.action: Quote the full price in writing before starting, including any add-on, and never add a charge mid-service.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: being charged more than you were quoted
issueTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: bataye gaye daam se zyada charge hone

issueTaxonomy.label: Staff behaviour / attitude
issueTaxonomy.action: Brief the floor on a fixed greeting and handover script, and name one person responsible for each client visit.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the way you were spoken to

issueTaxonomy.label: Hygiene / tool cleanliness
issueTaxonomy.action: Sanitise tools in front of the client and keep a visible sterilisation log at each station.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the cleanliness of the tools and towels

issueTaxonomy.label: Pushy upselling
issueTaxonomy.action: Ban mid-service upselling: offer add-ons once, at consultation, and never while the client is in the chair.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: feeling pushed into extras you did not want

issueTaxonomy.label: Product quality concerns
issueTaxonomy.action: Show the product brand and expiry to the client before use for any chemical service.

issueTaxonomy.label: Long wait despite appointment
issueTaxonomy.action: Track actual start time against booked time for one week and cut the number of parallel bookings per stylist.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the wait even though you had booked
issueTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: booking ke baad bhi karna pade intezaar

issueTaxonomy.label: Salon cleanliness / condition
issueTaxonomy.action: Reset the floor between clients: sweep, wipe the station, and change the cape and towel every time.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the state of the salon when you visited

issueTaxonomy.label: Phone / booking channel unresponsive
issueTaxonomy.action: Assign one person to the salon phone during opening hours and return every missed call the same day.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: not being able to get through to us
issueTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: phone par sampark na ho paane

praiseTaxonomy.label: Stylist skill and result
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: stylist ne bilkul waise hi kiya jaisa aap chahte the

praiseTaxonomy.label: Warm, patient staff
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the team made you feel welcome
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: team ne aapko comfortable mehsoos karaya

praiseTaxonomy.label: Clean and hygienic
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the salon felt clean and hygienic

praiseTaxonomy.label: Good consultation / advice
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: you were properly listened to first
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: pehle aapki baat dhyan se suni gayi
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseMarathi: आधी तुमचे म्हणणे नीट ऐकले गेले

voicePreset.greeting: Thank you for the honest feedback.
exampleReplies: Thank you for telling us — the result should have matched what you asked for. Please call the salon and ask for the manager so we can look at it with you.
So glad you loved it. Passing this on to the team.

staffAskScript.when: At the billing counter, once the client has seen the finished result in the mirror.
staffAskScript.line: If you are happy with how it turned out, would you mind sharing an honest review? The QR at the counter takes a minute.
staffAskScript.hinglishLine: Agar aapko result pasand aaya ho, toh ek honest review share kar dijiye. Counter ka QR ek minute lega.
staffAskScript.marathiLine: निकाल आवडला असेल तर तुमचा प्रामाणिक अभिप्राय द्याल का? काउंटरवरचा QR एक मिनिट घेतो.
doNot: Never offer a discount, free add-on or loyalty points for a review.
Never show the QR only to clients who seemed pleased.
Never type a review on a client's phone.
Never ask a client to remove or edit a review.

profileGapChecks.label: Service list and price range not published
No booking method visible on the listing

contentTemplates.label: Reply — unhappy with result
contentTemplates.body:
Thank you for telling us. What you asked for and what you got should have matched, and they did not. Please call the salon and ask for the manager so we can look at it with you directly.

— Team {{businessName}}

contentTemplates.label: Reply — positive review
contentTemplates.body:
Thank you — this means a lot to the team. See you next time.

— Team {{businessName}}

contentTemplates.label: Counter card headline
contentTemplates.body: Happy with how it turned out?

contentTemplates.label: Counter card subhead
contentTemplates.body: Scan and tell us honestly. One minute.
